vibe.verdict: A moody bar tab that finds the peas, Piaf and limo crew, but several drinks and props are made up and Shallow, the heart of the film, is missing.
missing: Ally singing Shallow with Jack on stage (Jack's show)
The guitar string ring (Jack's proposal at Noodles's place)
Ally's first Grammy night and Jack's pull-up on stage (the Coachella-style festival)
The Roy Orbison tribute at the Grammys
The Arizona ranch turned into a wind farm (Jack and Bobby)
ideas: Swap the 'Jack's order' line on 'Gin martini with a twist' for Jack's real line 'I just wanted to take another look at you.'
Put the peeled eyebrow on the printed menu as a lost property line, in place of 'Prices subject to change.'
Swap 'Truffle salted popcorn' for 'Guitar string ring pretzels', a nod to the ring Jack makes for Ally.
Swap 'Carried over' and 'Brought forward' for 'Twelve notes' and 'Same story', from Bobby's speech.
